verdict: Client is reaching a DP from a neighbor boundary group instead of its own. Happens when the neighbor DP shares an IP subnet with the client, even if the client's own boundary group DPs are healthy.
fix: Do not configure neighboring boundary groups that share IP subnets with the client's current boundary group. MECM's DP selection treats subnet-match as a strong signal and picks the subnet-local DP before respecting boundary-group hierarchy. Redesign the boundary groups so each subnet belongs to exactly one group, and fallback is to truly-remote DPs only.
